request.style: English, symphonic metal, fast riffs and double bass drums, a soaring female soprano and a powerful male voice, full orchestra and choir, thunderous and majestic, 140 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In my distress I called upon the Lord
To my God I cried for help
From his temple he heard my voice
My cry came before him, into his ears

[Verse]
Then the earth reeled and rocked
The foundations of the mountains trembled
Smoke went up from his nostrils
Devouring fire from his mouth

[Chorus]
He rode upon a cherub and flew
He came swiftly on the wings of the wind
He reached from on high, he took me
He drew me out of many waters

[Verse]
The Lord thundered in the heavens
The Most High uttered his voice
He sent out his arrows and scattered them
Lightnings and routed them

[Chorus]
He rode upon a cherub and flew
He came swiftly on the wings of the wind
He reached from on high, he took me
He drew me out of many waters

[Outro]
The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer
